full_text: Today my daughter, nerdsftw, gave a Thank You card to our Mayor for everything he’s done for our community during this troubling times. #covidkindness #thankyou #card #covid #covid_19 #covid19 @ The City of Marion… https://t.co/d3FKglnjpn

location_description: Marion is a city in Williamson and Johnson Counties, Illinois, United States, and is the county seat of Williamson County. The population was 16,855 at the 2020 census. It is part of a dispersed urban area that developed out of the early 20th-century coal fields.
